verdict.rationale: Ramp documents that it can send money abroad: international wires for bill payments, plus eligible stablecoin (USDC) Bill Pay payments. The only speed claim for international wires is "same-day", and "instant" payments are tied to RTP, which is not shown to cover cross-border transfers. Nothing evidences arrival abroad in under a minute. missing for 10: documented sub-minute cross-border settlement, a speed claim for stablecoin or international payouts, independent or hands-on corroboration of international transfer speed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can send money abroad that arrives in under a minute

citations.quote: Unlimited free same-day ACH and international wires for bill payments
Some schemas also support stablecoin identifiers such as USDC, which can be used for eligible stablecoin Bill Pay payments.
